example.title: Holly Hotel: a two-storey hotel-motel with a green entry canopy

brief: A c. 1980 two-storey hotel-motel: cream siding and white trim under a grey hipped roof, a projecting gabled entry and a green awning canopy with the name, clipped conifers along the front and a big car park. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
